name: Non-Detailed Project Report (NDPR)
description: Non-Detailed Project Report (NDPR) — compiled from the expert mapping document (mapping_source.xlsx). Sections, depth, table columns and scope boundaries are authoritative from that source.
system_instructions: You are a senior business analyst writing a formal Non-Detailed Project Report (NDPR) for Adani Energy Solutions Limited (AESL). Professional, precise, third-person business English. Be specific — pull real names, numbers, systems, dates and figures from the source material; never use vague placeholders. Each section must ADD new information — do not repeat content from other sections. Honour the 'MUST NOT INCLUDE' scope boundary supplied with each section. For table sections output a valid GitHub-flavoured Markdown pipe table with a header row and a separator row, using EXACTLY the columns named in the section spec. Do not use emoji.

sections.title: Part I - Basic Details
sections.instructions: Produce Part I of the NDPR as ONE markdown table with columns 'Sr. No | Required Details | Detailed Justification'. Include EXACTLY these rows, in order: 1 Index; 2 Name of Applicant; 3 Name of Capital Investment Work; 4 Nature of Capex Scheme; 5 Details of Location; 6 Date of Approval by Competent Authority; 7 Category of DPR; 8 Objective of Capital Investment; 9 Need Analysis; 10 List of Identical Schemes Previously Approved; 11 State Map Showing Location of the Scheme; 12 Brief Scope and Specifications of Work; 13 Any Reference of Study Report / Recommendation; 14 Estimated Cost; 15 Time Frame of the Expenditure; 16 Funding Arrangement; 17 Benefits / Impact; 18 Overall Cost-Benefit Analysis. For each row write a concrete Detailed Justification grounded in the project inputs and the source document; use 'Not Applicable' for items that do not apply (e.g. transmission-only items for a distribution/IT project); reference annexures where relevant ('attached as Annexure-1'); include figures, FY timelines and the Debt-to-Equity funding ratio where relevant. Keep each justification 1-4 sentences. Produce ~1000 words.

sections.title: Part II - Detailed Justification
sections.instructions: Produce Part II of the NDPR as ONE markdown table with columns 'Sr. No | Details | Detailed Description'. Include EXACTLY these rows, in order: 1 Need for an Investment; 2 Timelines of Project; 3 Scheme for Revised Approval / Scope / Cost; 4 Proposed Capital Investment Scheme; 5 Technical Justification; 6 Financial Justification; 7 Consent of M-DNAC; 8 Plan of Other Transmission Licensees / CTU; 9 Phasing of Investment; 10 Statutory / Safety Requirement; 11 Cost Assessment / Cost Break-up; 12 Least Cost Analysis / Alternatives; 13 If Not and If Deferred Analysis; 14 Cost Benefit Analysis; 15 Methodology of Put to Use of the Asset; 16 Constraints; 17 Inclusion in STU Plan / License; 18 Works Intended for Adaptation of Latest Technology; 19 Upstream / Downstream Arrangement; 20 Statutory Clearances and Project Layout; 21 Detailed Survey; 22 Past Trends and Future Projections; 23 Detailed Justification for Quantity Proposed; 24 Check List of Documents Appended. For each row write a concrete Detailed Description grounded in the project inputs and source document; use 'Not Applicable' where it does not apply; include cost break-up figures, ROI/payback, FY phasing and annexure references where relevant. Produce ~1300 words.
